verdict.rationale: Browserbase offers programmatically controlled browser sessions with full browser control (auto-waits, network interception, multi-tab), and it explicitly markets agents that log in, fill forms and handle login prompts to pull data from behind login walls. That covers the core of clicking and form-filling past authentication. Missing for 10: explicit docs showing continued interaction with a page in the same session after it was scraped or fetched, detailed documentation of login and auth persistence, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
